title: DECISION: test vectors from Python cryptography library oracle
description: All test vectors in did_verify.rs (DID key, public key hex, valid signature, wrong signature) were generated by the Python cryptography library and hardcoded as constants. The generation script is embedded in the test file comments showing the exact seed, library calls, and encoding steps. This is correct test practice: the Rust implementation is validated against an independent implementation (Python pyca/cryptography), not against itself. A test that signs with ed25519-dalek and verifies with ed25519-dalek proves only internal consistency, not interoperability or correctness against the spec.
